scope.files: Guarded git ls-files tracked working-copy files plus every existing docs/ file at this scan snapshot, deduplicated; both existing private build keys compared against each repository

disclaimer: Only literal occurrences in the selected working-copy files and listed encodings were checked. No key or key-derived digest/value is recorded.
This is a finite file snapshot, not a Git-history or all-files audit; untracked files outside docs/, ignored caches, external artifacts and later additions/changes are excluded.
Compressed, encrypted, split, transformed or otherwise obfuscated representations beyond the listed encodings are not established absent.
Native exported engines necessarily contain the pack key. This source/docs scan is not evidence of binary-key absence, key secrecy, unextractability or invulnerable protection.
Rerun after final documentation generation/staging if any selected file or new docs file changes before publication.
